column_source_invalid: Cannot recognize the keyword or formula. Restored the previous source.
column_source_unverified: Syntax recognized. Using {{source}}; {{keys}} are not listed in the schema, so values depend on the image TOML.
column_source_unchanged: Column title saved; the keyword or formula is unchanged.
column_source_help_syntax: Enter an image TOML field. Formulas start with = (added on save if omitted) and support arithmetic, parentheses, abs/log2/min/max.
column_source_help_validation: Save checks syntax; unlisted fields are allowed. Missing TOML values or division by zero display -.
column_source_help_multiple: Combine fields: =join(A,B) shows A, B; =join(A,"|",B) shows A|B; =list(A,B) shows [A, B]. Nest functions, for example =list(join(Normal_old,"|",Normal_new),BackTar_new,FLinkTar_new). A/B stand for field names.
column_source_help_aliases: AE Basic aliases: append _old or _new to Normal, BackTar, FLinkTar, or CWR for previous/current values. Names are case-sensitive.
column_source_help_delta: =CWR_new - CWR_old shows whole-number ΔCWR; =log2(CWR_new / CWR_old) shows ΔEV to 3 decimals. Both follow Normal|BackTar|FLinkTar order.
column_source_help_ae_gain: AEGain(new): =FLinkTar_old / BackTar_old(FLinkTar_new / BackTar_new) shows old(new); only new changes color.
column_source_help_colors: Above the positive threshold is red; below the negative threshold is blue. Other values stay unchanged.
column_source_help_save: Row Save checks the source and restores it if invalid; Complete saves the settings.
